      // PATCH NOTES //
      
    

    


      

        
v5.6.1 current build

        
FIX Nakamura HP reduced from 70 to 64

        
FIX Ghost Chip now guarantees evade for its duration — removed the 38% RNG check

        
FIX Heavy attack miss chance reduced from 22% to 10%

        
FIX Early economy — search_underpass gold increased from ¢15 to ¢28; tunnel_talk now awards ¢20 for the non-combat path

      

      

        
v5.6.0

        
FIX Difficulty rebalanced — all enemy ATK reduced by 1–2; Nakamura's rage multiplier lowered from 1.4× to 1.25× and rage threshold reduced; player starts with 32 HP and 3 DEF

        
NEW Mara's Flask is now a unique item — heals 20 HP and permanently grants +1 ATK when consumed; flagged so it can only apply once

      

      

        
v5.5.9

        
FIX NPC choices not refreshing after dialogue — choices panel now re-renders on every dialogue response, so new relationship-level options appear immediately without reopening the NPC screen

      

      

        
v5.5.8

        
FIX Mara romance route — level 4 exit options were routing to bridge_standoff, bypassing the factory entirely; both now correctly lead to factory_entrance

        
FIX Victory/gameover screen clipping on mobile — missing background and z-index caused game-screen elements to bleed through during transition

        
FIX Patch notes footer button wrapping — [ CLOSE ] bracket was dropping to second line on narrow screens; added white-space:nowrap to btn-sm globally

        
FIX Patch notes title button on mobile — split to two lines ([ PATCH NOTES ] / // v5.6.1 //) to prevent collision with EmuSoft badge

      

      

        
v5.5.7

        
NEW Title screen cityscape — upgraded to half-block Unicode art (▀) with full 24-bit green phosphor palette, 200×107 char resolution

        
FIX City panel frame — right edge no longer bleeds outside container; added min-width:0 and overflow clipping to flex panel

        
FIX Victory/gameover screens on mobile — overflow-y:auto and max-height:100vh prevent Mara epilogue text from running off-screen

      

      

        
v5.5.6

        
NEW Patch notes screen added — full changelog from v1 to current, accessible from title screen

        
NEW Scavenge system rebuilt — proper depth loop with go-deeper / extract flow after each action

        
FIX Scavenge lockup — combat-triggering actions now cleanly close scavenge before entering combat

      


      

        
v5.5.5

        
FIX ASCII panel toggle — [hide]/[show] moved outside collapsing panel so it can no longer bury itself

        
FIX ASCII frame rendering — CSS border replaces character-drawn box, eliminating font-width drift

        
NEW Hand-crafted ASCII art for all 30 story nodes — covers every scene with dedicated artwork

      


      

        
v5.5.4

        
FIX ASCII art overflow — removed word-break:break-all which was mangling box-drawing characters

        
FIX Fade-in animation — removed blur() from asciiIn keyframe which caused bleed artefacts

        
FIX Panel max-height increased to prevent bottom border clipping on taller frames

        
NEW ASCII fallbacks rewritten — consistent 36-char width, all frames properly bounded

      


      

        
v5.5.3

        
FIX Import/Export tab simplified to import-only — each save slot already has its own export button

        
FIX Tab relabelled IMPORT / EXPORT → IMPORT SAVE

      


      

        
v5.5.2

        
FIX Save slot [ EXPORT ] now opens export modal directly with slot data — no longer references a removed element

        
FIX Export button scoped correctly — only active when a game is loaded

      


      

        
v5.5.1

        
FIX Version string cascade bug — rebadge was double-suffixing (v5.5.1.1)

        
FIX Export clipboard — execCommand fallback added for file:// contexts

        
FIX SELECT ALL uses setSelectionRange for Android compatibility

      


      

        
v5.5

        
NEW [ COPY SAVE ] in-game header button — saves and exports to clipboard in one tap

        
NEW Export modal — fullscreen overlay with selectable textarea, built for Android copy workflow

        
FIX All clipboard ops have dual fallback: clipboard API → execCommand → manual instruction

      


      

        
v5.4

        
NEW Save system rebuilt — named slots per character, slot index, no single shared key

        
NEW Operative Files screen — pick, load, export, or delete individual saves

        
NEW Import / Export tab — JSON paste workflow for cross-version and cross-device migration

        
FIX Root cause resolved — localStorage partitioned per file path; confirmed cross-version saves require JSON transfer

      


      

        
v5.3

        
NEW Legacy save detection — scans all known keys from previous versions

        
NEW migrateSave() — safe field-by-field migration with STATE_DEFAULTS fallback for any missing fields

        
NEW Saves now stamped with _saveVer and _savedAt

        
FIX confirmLoad() skips dialog on title screen — nothing to lose

      


      

        
v5.2

        
FIX Scavenge buttons disabled on use — infinite money exploit closed

        
FIX ASCII art mobile overflow — overflow-x:hidden on scene panel

        
FIX EmuSoft badge brightness — color lifted from near-invisible dark green to readable mid-green

        
FIX Title screen overflow from wide AI-generated art

      


      

        
v5.1

        
FIX EmuSoft badge — position:fixed so it correctly pins to viewport bottom-right

        
FIX EmuSoft badge frame — redrawn with plain ASCII to fix box-drawing character width drift

        
FIX Final scene text corruption — renderNode cancels typewriter before new render; victory transition no longer corrupts text

        
FIX ASCII layout break — overflow and max-width constraints added

      


      

        
v5.0

        
NEW CRT effects restricted to title screen only

        
NEW Mara romance arc — 5-tier relationship, pink heart pips, romance-mode NPC panel, branching victory ending

        
NEW V2 narrative fully restored — stronger tunnel talk, Mara intel/backstory split, ghost operative, bridge moral choice

        
NEW Boot sequence animation

        
NEW Full mobile optimisation — 44px touch targets, portrait combat, landscape-safe layout

        
NEW MARA tab in Mission Log

      


      

        
v3

        
NEW NPC relationship engine — Mara and Gray with tiered dialogue

        
NEW Procedural scavenge system with risk tiers and depth mechanic

        
NEW Status effects — bleed, stun, overclocked

        
NEW Hunger and warmth needs system

        
NEW Enemy rage mode — Nakamura enters rage below 35% HP

        
NEW Combo system and Heavy Strike combat action

        
NEW Map screen and Mission Log (Story / Contacts / Notes tabs)

        
STORY 8 new nodes — maintenance hatch, service corridor, ghost encounter, bridge moral choice

      


      

        
v2

        
NEW AI-generated ASCII scene imagery per node (cached in save)

        
NEW Ghost Chip item — dodge mechanic and stealth bypass path

        
NEW Security Hound and Ghost Operative enemy types

        
NEW Kill counter, turn counter, ambient rain on title screen

        
STORY Expanded to 20+ nodes — factory silent route, Mara backstory, shard truth, bridge negotiation

      


      

        
v1 initial release

        
NEW Core engine — turn-based combat, inventory, shop, XP / levelling

        
NEW CRT aesthetic — scanlines, phosphor glow, vignette, glitch title

        
NEW Typewriter text effect with click-to-skip

        
NEW Save / load via localStorage

        
NEW 4 enemy types — Ganger, Guard, Enforcer, Nakamura

        
NEW Black market shop, 7 items with auto-equip

        
STORY 15 nodes — Highway 9 underpass to Sector 7 bridge
